Strategy: Dead-zone avoidance: penalize bins whose post-placement residual falls in the small unusable band (0, item/3), while scoring all other bins by tightest fit; this avoids stranding tiny slivers that fit nothing, preferring either an exact close or a remainder large enough to reuse. It can fail when the penalized bins were actually the best available and the fallback bins waste more space.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) - (500.0 if (r - item > 0 and r - item < item / 3) else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
